key_insight: 2D/3D perovskite interface band alignment is highly sensitive to surface termination and chemical composition, with interface formation also inducing a measurable electrostatic potential slope.
engineering_relevance: This work helps guide interface engineering for more stable and efficient perovskite solar cells by identifying compositions and terminations that shift work function and band offsets.
method: Atomistic modeling of (PEA)2PbI4 on complex 3D perovskite surfaces
Consistent calculation of work function, electron affinity, and band offset
evidence_signal: The abstract reports preliminary computed band offsets with valence offsets spanning about 0.2 to 0.7 eV and conduction offsets around 0.25 eV, strongly depending on termination and chemistry.
watch_item: Results are preliminary and based on simulated interfaces, so experimental validation is still needed before design rules can be generalized.
paper_title: Material chemical composition impacts on the band alignments: preliminary results on the 3D/2D perovskite interfaces
